statement: A ruling that sets conditions on an artifact whose behaviour can change under the same name must pin every condition to one behavioural identity. The cejel v27 promotion ruling (PR 542) required a soak release, an independent review and a shadow board, then required a scoring fix (#527) to v27 itself; as written, each gate could certify a different v27 from the one promoted. Review also found it restating a measurement method as current fact ("the board fetches depth-1 clones") copied from a newer entry, while an older method-change record (2026-10-11) said the board moved to full-history clones. Rules: name the candidate by its behaviour fingerprint and commit, and reset every gate when its scoring changes; before restating how a measurement is taken, read the latest method-change record, not the most recent document that mentions it.
